tasks.title: E27 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E27 (Kit map: what this ship can test). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E27.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E27/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E27/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Deterministic kit-map backend and release checks
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is a fresh-session assignment. The E27 design is frozen. Implement the winning rules and review dispositions below, not obsolete design interfaces. Work only inside owned_paths, including tests. At planning time the implementation roots, non-pharmacy configuration, generated API models and E27 request file do not exist. Recheck actual files and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything; preserve concurrent work. Do not edit another epic, another task, the product package, shared contracts/generated files, shared build configuration, AI-USE-LOG.md or the design. Return any missing shared declaration or required out-of-scope change to the coordinator through PLAN.md C1 to C8; the coordinator must file it in docs/requests/E27.md. A request is not an accepted contract. Do not invent an interface, DTO field, table, endpoint, operationId or tool invocation to fill a gap.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock and correction-aware time; 5.3 MissionClock with opaque version; 5.4 Unit/Quantity with finite Decimal and explicit UCUM; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on wire; 5.6 immutable validated ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader and ReleaseCheck.check; 5.7 ReadSnapshot/UnitOfWork and their factories; 5.8 full operation/target/semantic-parameter/body identity, mission-life receipt and current ResultVisibility; 5.9 reference-only audit; 5.10 shared health/scheduler/tasks; 5.11 typed HubSettings and bounded SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry with declared dependencies and late binding. No replacement transaction, clock, loader, ledger, retry engine or queue. SYSTEM 6 requires uv --project hub, generated crew_health.contracts_gen/@crew-health/contracts and generated import contracts. SYSTEM 8.1 fixes seams, 8.2 guidance eligibility, 8.3/8.4 object/field grants and authority, 8.5 local site/custody and 8.6 durability. SYSTEM 9/10 defines dependencies and kernel.testing. Kernel fakes are component-test aids against published protocols only; production has typed unknown/unavailable behavior. End-to-end tests use real composition/auth/configuration/SQLite and no mocks inside the hub. Only optional external processes may be absent or use documented fakes. No runtime sample fallback.

Content comes from validated versioned configuration/backend state; explicit examples/fixtures load only in their test/demo profile. Expected clinical results need independent source-checked golden evidence, not a calculation copied from the input document. Missing/stale/unknown stays explicit. Review absence is a visible not_clinically_reviewed state under Q1/Q7/Q18, never a runtime sign-off gate; source/hash/purpose/pin/environment/origin/eligibility checks remain mandatory. Missing mandatory copy or contracts leaves the affected feature disabled and its positive acceptance open. Never weaken a safety invariant, hardcode content, turn absence into zero, expose private text in logs/cache, or let an assistant mutate safety. Tests first on critical paths, property tests for every parser/rule, all applicable AGENTS section 6 failures, exact T27/R/V/D/invariant traces. Do not skip/xfail/filter missing positive acceptance. Run listed gates; report missing prerequisites and failures. Done requires actual owned behavior/evidence and passing gates; whole-epic completion additionally requires all tasks, resolved independent build review, CI and coordinator AI-use rows. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

Build only E27's deterministic kit-map backend, release validation, pure gate and capability contribution, with its focused tests. Sources: design sections 3 to 6, 8, 9 to 12 and 15 (docs/tdd/E27.md:88,226,411,508,633,715); CONTRACTS 11/21/22/25; SYSTEM 4.4,5.6/5.7/5.12,8.1/8.2. T2 owns authoring/configuration, T3 owns screens, T4 owns complete scenario and venue evidence. You own no migration or table. In particular, do not create kitmap_check/kitmap_whatif despite SYSTEM 4.2's inventory: R44 and SYSTEM 5.8 explicitly require read-only what-if. C1 asks the coordinator to resolve the inventory and allocate module.py and guidance paths omitted from frozen section 13. Do not create those files under this assignment. Full acceptance waits for the coordinator's separately owned module registration and early guidance delivery; no guidance copy inside kitmap.

Pure domain: design 3.1's Instrument, CapabilityWords, ConfirmingTest, ConditionRow, SupplyDef, KitMapDoc; 3.2's evaluate_condition, evaluate_kit, count_states, summarize_regions, diff_states, kit_gate and derive_capabilities; TestEvaluation, ConditionEvaluation, StateCounts, CountBases, RegionSummary, GateResult and KitCapability. Preserve generated enum vocabulary through pure kernel/enums mappers, immutable values, document/test/provider order and exact nullability. Reject rows disappear from every count/mark/gate. CONTRACTS 21 precedence is full nonempty confirming test, then any empty-instrument examination, then needs_test_not_aboard. Partial equipment never satisfies a joint test. Minimum missing cardinality ties to first test; preserve its instrument order. Regions follow common.schema body_region then whole_body, with one ordered mark per present state. Camera estimates, imports, manually entered observations and supply/training additions never substitute for a confirming instrument. Gate output is exactly KitCheck: can, instrument_ids, missing_instrument_ids, condition_ids, cliff_urls, text, kit_map_version, environment_id; no patient values. Unknown/rejected condition or capability and input bound violations return typed findings. derive_capabilities contributes KitCapability only; E05 owns device/readiness overlay and cannot promote not_in_kit.

Application: design 4.1/4.2's ReleasePins with kit_map/ui_copy/skills_catalog/onboard_plans/role_rules; KitMapRelease, KitMapReleaseSource, KitMapContext, SupplyAddition(quantity: Quantity), SkillAddition, PlanningDelta, PlanColumns, PlanChange and CoverChange. PlanColumnsPort.row_columns(ctx, *, kit, plan_ids), plans_changed(ctx, *, base_kit, delta) and CoverPlanningPort.cover_changed(ctx, *, add_supplies) are E27-owned consumer protocols, implemented by E28/E32. KitQueryPort.kit_instruments/instrument retain exact pinned lookup. SYSTEM uses KitGate/KitMapQueries/EquipmentFacts; E05 documents name consolidation and missing GateOutcome/SnapshotConn/readiness methods (docs/tdd/E05.md:145). Do not silently publish KitGatePort aliases or guess GateOutcome fields from comments. C3 must settle complete declarations and snapshot mapping before those bindings. Import only another module's application ports. Break E05/E27 and E28/E32 cycles through published consumer-owned protocols and late bindings, never factory cycles or copied providers. Missing provider DTOs are not permission for a fake protocol. StockReader.stock and RosterPort need the agreed caller-snapshot binding; MissionStatePort.current uses the actual E23 caller-bound facts (docs/tdd/E23.md:427). Unknown readiness is not every packed instrument usable. Do not emit a numeric executable-now basis if its factual support is unknown. C3 must settle how the closed response expresses absent plan/cover providers without fabricated zero/empty results.

GetKitMapView.execute and RunWhatIf.execute capture one ReadSnapshot with snapshot.release and snapshot.now; do not manually open SQL transactions or read other modules' tables. All ports share its release/environment/stock/roster/readiness/time. Config-Release must be that exact release, even if activation commits before response. Use the agreed header binding from C2, not a guessed app middleware hook. Explicit environment overrides only the environment. All five pins must participate in coherent cache identity, including old open plan runs. No active-release substitution after cache eviction or missing pin. ConfigKitMapReleaseSource in adapters/config_source.py parses and validates before activation through E01's accepted lifecycle. C2 must supply the publication/pin-retention binding; .on_activated is absent from SYSTEM and cannot be invented. Instance-owned bounded caches, no module mutable state or heavy active-request parsing.

RunWhatIf validates generated requests.schema KitMapWhatIf: at least one addition, IDs against pinned configuration/roster, unique instrument IDs and unique supply/skill additions, nonempty unique person IDs, finite positive Decimal, bounded exponent/scale/quantity and every list/string/body length before expensive work. Plan/cover deltas are delegated to owners under ctx. persisted is false; no audit/outbox/command/replication write, including rejected input. Bounds come from design 11 registered through SYSTEM 5.11 after C2, not defaults or new settings invented here.

Release checks: design 8.2 B, 11a/b/c, row-review attribution 12, CAM, C1 and EX. Use ReleaseCheck.check(CandidateRelease)->tuple[Finding,...], not .run or an untyped activated hook. Schema/source/cross-reference/semantic failure rejects the candidate and keeps the last good release. Q1/Q7 leave unreviewed source-eligible content usable with its label. A camera_estimate instrument in any confirming test is always a code-level refusal, not a setting. EX refuses example kit in LIVE. C1 can report absent proposed copy only as the design's pending-contract notice; never downgrade an actual validation failure. Cold-start invalid release keeps normal kit routes off and E01's signed static/printed help path available. Accepted current-release parsing must not be evicted while serving. No read path writes. Default method/needs_text only where the schema explicitly defines them.

API: api/router.py exposes only getKitMap GET /v1/kit-map and kitMapWhatIf POST /v1/kit-map/what-if, with exact x-roles from docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:6265/6332. No invented How we know operationId; C4 must supply the effective endpoint before adding it under this task. Require real session. Generated models validate bodies and responses. Map malformed JSON/nonfinite tokens to MALFORMED_REQUEST, unsupported content type to UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, semantic input to INVALID_VALUE with all safe pointers, unknown environment to MALFORMED_REQUEST, missing session/access to UNAUTHENTICATED/UNAUTHORIZED_SCOPE. Storage/config/provider faults propagate through ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and shared INTERNAL_ERROR handling, never a successful empty view. Use SYSTEM TemplateRenderer.render(field_key, template, values) on hub state-dependent text. Gate joins use CONTRACTS 21's comma/or rules; missing_text uses and. Do not send R27-1/2/3/7/16 proposed fields through a closed schema before C4 approval/codegen. Once R27-7 exists, implement the approved role-split reader in this owned backend: own personal streams only, habitat authorization, hashed aggregates only, no participant rows or cross-person selector.

Write tests first in hub/tests/kitmap for T27-01/02/03/04/05/11/12/13/14/19/26/27/31 and KM-I1 to I12, including properties, independently stated precedence cases, seven-row station 0/3/4 and Mars/ECG 1/3/3 vectors from CONTRACTS 20 and example value wrappers. Those counts never become 119-row expected constants. Correct KM-I11: measured_here for a usable subset cannot exceed packed measured_here; total is equal, other buckets may increase. T27-06/07/08/15/17/20/23/29 add real composition HTTP integration for purity, scratch content/copy changes, real environment control, rejected/corrupt activation, cold safe mode, optional-part loss, settings bounds and coherent snapshots under concurrent activation/stock use. Use E01's published clock/fault boundary; never invent a storage spy as end-to-end evidence. Port fakes suffice for isolated pure/component assertions only; T4 repeats the complete provider journeys. No-configuration requests return typed failure, never sample kit. Run cache churn/oversized-body/load checks without weakening help latency. Register exact markers in the owning conftest only through E01/E21's accepted convention.

AGENTS failure coverage here: power loss/rollback around configuration activation through the real owner, duplicate/mismatched/late HTTP input, forward/backward clock and mission boundary with one captured as_of, disk full/I/O on shared config reads/activation, corrupt/missing documents, conflicting readiness rather than optimistic defaults, concurrent readers/activation/use, link outage without reads of GroundLink, missing/incapacitated operator facts and all provenance-role cases. E05 owns durable request effects and their faults; T4 proves them. Component tests for missing copy and provider faults cannot replace required positive integration. Finish with >=95% branch coverage per domain/application file, full safety decision conditions, complexity <=15 and zero non-equivalent critical mutants through C6's shared gate; aggregate pytest-cov alone is supplementary. Done means the real two routes, immutable gate/capability derivation and checks work, all assigned regressions pass, and unbuilt provider/binding/contract acceptance remains explicitly open.

uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/kitmap hub/tests/kitmap
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/kitmap hub/tests/kitmap
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/kitmap hub/tests/kitmap
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output /tmp/e27-t1-imports.ini
uv run --project hub lint-imports --config /tmp/e27-t1-imports.ini
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated coverage safety mutations

Golden Q26 cases require independently checked expectations; a round trip of the authored document is not medical validation. Derive parser inputs from the pinned configuration/saved source inventory in memory; any stored synthetic clinical fixture belongs to T4 under eval/scenarios/e27, never under the production authoring tree. Test the saved-source/no-fetch path, wrong content hash refusing replacement without explicit refresh, bounded timeout/retry/byte limits and sequential request behavior with injected time/network boundaries. All fetch operational bounds must use the C2-accepted operational configuration, not literals hidden in request code or a locally invented shared settings interface.

Test deterministic rebuild, missing E32 input, no partial successful artifact on I/O/disk-full interruption, restart/retry, and a source/configuration text edit changing generated content without code changes. Do not build a replacement filesystem transaction/recovery framework: if durable publication needs a shared primitive not provided by E01/E20, request it through C2 and leave publication blocked. The final runtime file must pass effective schemas and T1's semantic validator through C6's shared corpus gate without duplicating that validator in check.py. Tests must not edit shipped configuration or safety mappings. No per-person health or venue participant data enters authoring. Do not fetch external medical facts to repair a source contradiction; retain and report it.

Done means the complete 119-row document, source sidecars and genuine second-check evidence pass check.py, parser/content tests and hub corpus validation with E32's actual input. Restore base by removing toggles, not a config write. persisted must be false, no Idempotency-Key and no offline mutation/replay. When the hub is unavailable, E20's versioned public cache may display only stale view with as_of and version; toggles disabled. E20 owns cache implementation, not E29 despite frozen wording. If no valid stale copy exists, use skeleton/failure state without invented labels or a second local storage system.

Freshness, ordering and reconnection follow design 7 and r1.11: first load skeleton without marks; refetch retains data only with configured stale label/as_of, otherwise skeleton; errors never zero. config.release_activated invalidates both views and fetches configuration first, then base, then recomputes the current hypothetical inputs. environment.activated and supply.used invalidate the affected results too. Disconnect/gap/reconnect and CURSOR_EXPIRED require shared event-client recovery plus view refresh, not continuing an old cursor. Drop removed candidates with configured words, otherwise preserve valid selected inputs. Each base/what-if request has a latest-issued sequence and expected environment/release; reject delayed or superseded responses even after AbortController races. Use Config-Release header matching current config. UI debounce/refetch/discard operational bounds must be registered through C2, not hardcoded 150 ms or three tries from the older design. No fabricated success after retry exhaustion.

HowWeKnow uses only C4's approved reader: own person's Live/Replay/Sim streams and dates, separately authorized habitat sources, aggregate result-panel metrics with unit/people/windows/pairs/scenarios/failures/hash/run/time as applicable, and review/version counts. No personal selector, other person's devices/dates, participant-code rows, raw CSV, prompts or log exposure. Station/ground/operator/editor have null personal data; editor habitat is null per approved R27-7. A medical officer role is not another person's provenance grant. Missing metrics show configured Not measured yet only after that reader/copy exists; unavailable reader is a distinct error. Clear any personal in-memory data on session change/revocation through E03's mechanism. Keep numerical/model/clinical/mission statuses distinct.

Write Vitest and browser regressions first for T27-21/22/24/36, KM-I12, H27-6/7/8, R02/R43/R44/R46, V76/V77/V79/V80/V98 and D28/D29/D31/D32. Component inputs may use the exact value of package examples, not their metadata wrapper; no clinical content literal copied into production. Test all states, every required missing copy key, shape-plus-word accessibility, aria-pressed buttons, aria-live counts, keyboard region selection and form links. Include scratch configured label/template edits with unchanged bundle (T27-07), callback ordering, environment/release/stock races, reconnect/410, candidate removal and abort-late-result races. Tests use no wall-clock assumptions; timing is through the documented UI test boundary. Do not create tests that merely assert the same computation you implemented.

Real-browser cases run Playwright against a running real hub/composition root and temporary real SQLite with E21's explicit demo fixture, T1/T2 real outputs, E03's Today/Records mount and E21 result panel. No route interception, fake API server or dependency overrides inside that hub. Compare all 119-row counts on Today, kit view and panel to one response version; the seven-row fixture cannot close D28. Verify planning changes/restoration and negative event/write evidence, real environment switch and full no-number-without-artifact How we know roles. T4 repeats the complete cross-module journeys; do not claim its assistant/handoff durability proof from your component tests. E21 owns V98 scanner; run it on actual source and bundle after integration. Missing source/client/runtime/slot/approved-copy/toolchain blocks affected gates, no skip or placeholder app.

Applicable faults: hub/model/device/link absence, stale cached content, corrupt/missing configuration, clock jump/as_of, two-client supply changes, interrupted/retried fetches, missing roster/incapacitated subject data and current cross-crew/session privacy. These are read-only controls, so do not introduce a queue, SQLite schema or record/crash-recovery code. Preserve the independent help entry on all feature states via E03. Done means accepted contracts/copy are present, components and genuine mounted browser flows pass, every required state is truthful and no runtime content/arithmetic is embedded in the bundle. Full study collection, backend implementation and shell/provider edits remain with their owners.

ticket_tasks.title: Real-stack acceptance and measured venue evidence
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is a fresh-session assignment. The E27 design is frozen. Implement the winning rules and review dispositions below, not obsolete design interfaces. Work only inside owned_paths, including tests. At planning time the implementation roots, non-pharmacy configuration, generated API models and E27 request file do not exist. Recheck actual files and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything; preserve concurrent work. Do not edit another epic, another task, the product package, shared contracts/generated files, shared build configuration, AI-USE-LOG.md or the design. Return any missing shared declaration or required out-of-scope change to the coordinator through PLAN.md C1 to C8; the coordinator must file it in docs/requests/E27.md. A request is not an accepted contract. Do not invent an interface, DTO field, table, endpoint, operationId or tool invocation to fill a gap.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock and correction-aware time; 5.3 MissionClock with opaque version; 5.4 Unit/Quantity with finite Decimal and explicit UCUM; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on wire; 5.6 immutable validated ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader and ReleaseCheck.check; 5.7 ReadSnapshot/UnitOfWork and their factories; 5.8 full operation/target/semantic-parameter/body identity, mission-life receipt and current ResultVisibility; 5.9 reference-only audit; 5.10 shared health/scheduler/tasks; 5.11 typed HubSettings and bounded SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry with declared dependencies and late binding. No replacement transaction, clock, loader, ledger, retry engine or queue. SYSTEM 6 requires uv --project hub, generated crew_health.contracts_gen/@crew-health/contracts and generated import contracts. SYSTEM 8.1 fixes seams, 8.2 guidance eligibility, 8.3/8.4 object/field grants and authority, 8.5 local site/custody and 8.6 durability. SYSTEM 9/10 defines dependencies and kernel.testing. Kernel fakes are component-test aids against published protocols only; production has typed unknown/unavailable behavior. End-to-end tests use real composition/auth/configuration/SQLite and no mocks inside the hub. Only optional external processes may be absent or use documented fakes. No runtime sample fallback.

Content comes from validated versioned configuration/backend state; explicit examples/fixtures load only in their test/demo profile. Expected clinical results need independent source-checked golden evidence, not a calculation copied from the input document. Missing/stale/unknown stays explicit. Review absence is a visible not_clinically_reviewed state under Q1/Q7/Q18, never a runtime sign-off gate; source/hash/purpose/pin/environment/origin/eligibility checks remain mandatory. Missing mandatory copy or contracts leaves the affected feature disabled and its positive acceptance open. Never weaken a safety invariant, hardcode content, turn absence into zero, expose private text in logs/cache, or let an assistant mutate safety. Tests first on critical paths, property tests for every parser/rule, all applicable AGENTS section 6 failures, exact T27/R/V/D/invariant traces. Do not skip/xfail/filter missing positive acceptance. Run listed gates; report missing prerequisites and failures. Done requires actual owned behavior/evidence and passing gates; whole-epic completion additionally requires all tasks, resolved independent build review, CI and coordinator AI-use rows. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

Build only E27's verification/evidence pipeline: complete real-stack scenario tests plus the venue methodology, collector and deterministic analysis defined in design 5.4/12/15. All tests, including study-analysis tests, live in eval/scenarios/e27; no product logic fixes in this task. All study code/data/documents and the one aggregate output are exactly owned_paths from docs/tdd/E27.md:794. T1/T2/T3 own implementation. E21 owns runner/fixture/scenario registry/result-panel/scanner, E06 camera worker, E30 pair study and E18 comparisons. Use their published interfaces and return fixes to owners. Never create a second runner/browser launcher, seed clinical state by SQL, or synthesize successful expected result artifacts to get a gate green.

First read design 12's complete T27 matrix and PLAN.md's end-to-end table. Implement every promised V/D clause, not a smoke-test alias. Register actual node IDs with E21's source-clause mechanism and use design's static ID markers only after E01/E21 supplies registration. Own eval/scenarios/e27/conftest.py and expected-ids.txt as design names them; assert collection using the real runner's accepted inventory, not a raw pytest -q summary diff that can pass with missing tests. Include V76/V77/V78/V79/V80/V92/V98 and D28/D29/D30/D31/D32, every E27 work package, R02/R07/R43/R44/R45/R46/R47/R59 and KM-I1 to I12. T1 owns pure T27-01/02/03/04/05/11/12/13/14/19/26/27/31; T2 T27-18; T3 T27-21/22/24/36. Reuse their evidence and add the real end-to-end level for all scenarios; do not reimplement their modules.

Every acceptance journey must call the hub HTTP API through E01 create_app(settings), with actual module discovery/auth/generated boundary/configuration/repositories/unit-of-work/audit/ledger/outbox and SQLite in a temporary directory, or use E21's Python Playwright binding against that running hub. Kernel fakes may not replace services inside it. Optional external model/device/link processes may be absent or their documented adapter fake; SIM/replay identity stays explicit. The hub reads real explicit fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 input through E21's bootstrap, not completed response examples as seed state. C1/C2/C5/C6 supply the actual callable test/clock/fault/launcher contracts. Missing bindings are blocking requests, never invented APIs, monkeypatches or skip/xfail. Run real owners for requested positive integration even if they are optional in minimal production.

V76/D28/T27-07/18/21: real authored 119-row release, every row exactly one computed state, all links and notice, API/Today/kit-view/result-panel counts equal under one release. Apply scratch kit/test/copy edits using the actual createConfigRelease/getConfigRelease/activateConfigRelease operations (docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:708,811,881), including the published validation and D8 ETag flow. Read their complete bodies and use the effective generated operations before invocation. Do not add new route names to make setup convenient. Independently checked vector expectations remain separate seven-row tests. No safety mapping edit; activation/revert cannot change existing warning state or pins. V77/D29/T27-06/15: toggle ECG on/off; compare exact changed[] and marks, base restored, Planning view visible, no application/kit/audit/outbox/ledger/replication mutation. Use owner-provided diagnostics to prove no write, not unauthorized cross-table SQL. V79/D31/T27-08: real proposed/confirmed station-to-lunar environment switch, default view/Today update, explicit Mars query correct independently.

V78/D30/T27-10/28/30/32/33/34/35: validate actual request_measurement ModelAction through real E12/E13 mapping into E05 createMeasurementRequest with injected authorized episode and decision text. Do not send unsupported condition_ids/decision_affected to propose_measurement's current closed tool. C4 must resolve that boundary. Supported pulse returns a truthful KitCheck and proposal; absent ECG commits unavailable with no allowed_actions/person task plus one unresolved gap, required field sources/form links. Follow the real conversation/assessment into act 5, handoff preview, explicit human approval, queued outage and delivered authorized ground snapshot. Read provider OpenAPI/design before calling their exact operations. Do not bypass a missing assessment/handoff provider by asserting a fake list contains a gap. The ring remains dashed after substitute/manual checks, no diagnostic exclusion.

T27-32 enumerates no episode (audited unavailable request, no invented episode/gap), empty condition_ids, multiple conditions with first eligible plan, absent plan/step and authored alternatives or []. consequence is decision_affected, not fabricated text. T27-33 uses current object/field/action grants: cross-person denied, explicitly shared positive case, revoked grant denied and no officer/open-help blanket privilege. Incapacitated-subject fixed help/manual capture and limited summary remain available without model/devices/ground while unsupported chart read/proposal is denied. T27-34/35 distinguish packed but disconnected with configured manual method, packed but lost/broken, truly absent instrument, absent/on-EVA/unqualified operator and configured context inapplicability. Missing configuration/protocol cannot be replaced by an always-true fake policy. Do not assert the retired byte-identical 422 cache contract for P2 content. SYSTEM 5.8 reauthorizes original owner records, stores references/keyed fingerprints rather than private text and returns a validated accepted_command receipt after 24 hours. Test same identity, changed body/target/parameters, cache expiry, revoked access, concurrent identical commands and changed environment/release without another request/gap. E05 owns all transaction changes.

Fault injection around every E05 request/gap/audit/event/receipt write and commit: process death/power loss, SQLite disk full/I/O/integrity/lock, crash after commit before response, recovery and retry. Assert all-or-none accepted effects, no duplicate gap/task, verified audit head and durable identity, using E01's real fault controls/owner diagnostics. T27-29: hold a snapshot while another real client activates/releases, consumes stock and switches environment; response and Config-Release are all old, next request all new. All five pins survive cache eviction, missing pins fail without active substitution. Clock forward/backward corrections and mission boundaries preserve captured as_of and original evidence timing; delayed/duplicate old events cannot restore stale UI state. Model stopped, adapters absent, long link outage/backlog, missing/corrupt config, missing/incapacitated crew and cross-crew privacy cover every applicable AGENTS section 6 fault.

V92/T27-16 uses real E28 PlanColumnsPort and E32 CoverPlanningPort/StockReader/overlay: joint instrument/supply/skill addition changes plans/officer dependencies/cover, only instrument addition moves rings, no writes and no mixed snapshot during actual stock use. V98/D32/T27-21/36 checks actual built bundle with E21 scanner and real full-document count equality. Delayed responses/release/environment mismatch, event gaps/reconnect/CURSOR_EXPIRED and stock use from another client must not resurrect old counts; missing required copy disables feature and leaves positive acceptance failed. T27-17/20/23 proves every release check, invalid camera-confirmation activation retaining last good release, corrupt/no-release startup with signed static/printed emergency help, no model/device/link dependency, bounded oversized parsing/cache churn and help first-screen p95 <=500 ms under load. Performance thresholds use design 11 and measured reference hardware; absence is not a passing CI measurement.

V80/T27-24 uses C4's approved How we know API and real screen. Before evidence exists every required metric reads configured Not measured yet, never zero; with evidence each value/unit/denominator resolves to its artifact hash and panel. Personal streams only for current person's crew session, personal null otherwise, habitat authorized separately (editor null), no participant fields or other-person selector. Test current role/grant/session changes, rejected unexpected fields and private canaries on actual responses/logs/events/cache/export surfaces rather than empty nonexistent services. Source review labels remain independent from eligibility and clinical validity.

Venue build: PROTOCOL.md, CONSENT.md, study.json, raw-schema.json, result.schema.json, FROZEN.json, collect.py and analyze.py are exactly design 5.4. C7 must supply frozen window/rate/tolerance values, actual approved coordinator consent configuration and E06's camera-window protocol (no E06 technical design exists now). Never invent those values, a worker endpoint, permission or metric_id vocabulary. Q5/Q6/Q8 settle team-member consenting adults and laptop-webcam/manual-30-second pulse reference, oximeter if available; no external volunteer recruitment or two-camera claim. Methodology and consent hashes, actual build identity, release/camera versions, settings and analysis hash are frozen before first participant row. Obtain actual per-participant agreement before any capture. No human collection runs as part of software CI. If collection readiness/consent/worker interface is absent, finish code/analysis tests and report actual venue acceptance open, never fabricated raw data.

Collector uses the published E06 interface and one injected monotonic time base, with corrected UTC/clock-discontinuity provenance from SYSTEM 5.2. Conditions are rest, light_change, recovery, paced_breathing, natural_breathing as design defines, with frozen safe protocol and independent manual observer. No dangerous induced physiology. Raw fields exactly design 5.4, finite typed quantities with /min/s/ms, participant code, consent/frozen proof, window times, manual count/duration/counter, optional oximeter, independent pulse/breath results/refusal codes, exclusion reason and clock discontinuity. Missing reading stays null/empty with reason, never a value. No stored frames, names or demographics; no clinical-record writes, model prompts/indexing, ground logs or API raw rows. Bound collection/output/arrays through the approved methodology and operational settings. Do not add an ad hoc I/O recovery framework; shared missing artifact publication primitive is C2/C7, not a local substitute.

Analysis is deterministic and offline: manual_count*60/manual_count_seconds reference, attempted/refused/missing-reference/paired windows; participant-first MAE and bias, beside window-level results with both denominators; optional oximeter separate; paced/natural breathing separate; pulse-only reading counts as breathing refusal. Metronome setting is not measured breathing. Every metric has people/windows/pairs, unit/status and hashes. No pairs is not_measured_yet; one camera against two agreeing remains unmeasured with reason. Pre-specified permitted exclusions are counted. Missing adult/consent evidence or changed frozen inputs aborts publication; do not exclude it and publish a valid-looking result. Withdrawn participant rows are removed before publication and aggregates recomputed, with the retention boundary kept explicit. Participant rows remain repository-only; only hashed aggregates enter eval/results/venue-study.json and E21's result panel. Do not fabricate assistant timing/rules-alone comparisons; E21/E18 supply those measured artifacts, E30 supplies pair results under the same protocol.

T27-25 tests first with explicit synthetic raw fixtures inside eval/scenarios/e27, clearly separated from actual study raw: exclusions, participant/window weighting, denominators, manual zero/negative/missing/nonfinite/overflow, parser properties, independent pulse/breath refusals, missing oximeter/reference, paced/natural split, clock discontinuity, consent/adult/frozen hash refusal, changed script/settings/hash, withdrawal and byte-identical rerun. A fixture cannot populate the published venue artifact as a measured trial. A scratch protocol/copy edit changes validated behavior with no code changes, but never retunes held-out thresholds after freeze.

Done: every real-stack V/D/critical path above is collected and passes with explicit mode evidence, scenario trace complete, all owned software/static gates green and actual study publication reproduces byte for byte from genuinely collected frozen raw rows. A code-complete analyzer does not finish E27-05. Mode scopes are source-derived and registered before execution. Stub/ci runs every software clause including the adversarial V78/D30 proposal; it never requires volunteers or an actual camera. The stopped command selects only the independent V76/V77/V79/V80/V92/V98 and D28/D29/D31/D32 journeys plus KM-I9/I10; those tests must not start a model to pass. Live/table_min runs the actual applicable live/reference clauses plus genuine venue artifact verification; D30's pinned adversarial request remains a stub obligation, not a requirement that the live model choose an ECG. E21's clause registry records incompatible source-derived clauses as not_selected, retaining them in the full denominator; it never classifies a failing or missing provider as incompatible. No skip/xfail is a successful evidence status. C6 must provide this agreed scoped execution before the gates are runnable. Real-camera/live/reference obligations stay open until executed. Final report --check must retain those open clauses. C6 must extend the shared branch/condition/complexity/mutation scope to E27 and reject zero selection/missing tests/surviving non-equivalent mutants. Run full hub and UI suites after fixes; no changes in this task to silence their owners' failures. Return unresolved requests and CI/hardware/study evidence status plainly.
